The MCP noise tax

Every tool you add to a model's context spends attention before it spends tokens, and that bill is invisible in the dashboard.

Where the tax hides

The schema is the tax: each description competes with the others for the same slice of attention.

What to do instead

Keep one tool until a second one can prove it pays for itself in a measured run.
